market_outlook.short_term: Markets volatile and risk-off near-term. Iran war escalation keeps oil elevated, pressuring equities and spiking rates. S&P 500 likely range-bound with downside risk if strikes intensify. Tech rotation from chips to software continues. Yen intervention risk adds FX noise. Expect 2-4% volatility in equities over next 2-3 weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: AI capex cycle (Phase 1 per BlackRock) supports 6-12 month tech upside. Fed rate path remains the key variable: if inflation eases post-oil shock, growth re-rates. K-shaped economy creates sector divergence. Geopolitical trade rerouting (India-Russia, EU-Brazil) creates structural commodity winners. Buffett's bear market discipline (headline 3) remains relevant if oil shock deepens.
